title: Cc, Bcc and conversation threads
problem: Replies had no copy fields and long conversations were hard to follow.
now: Every reply has To, Cc and Bcc; older messages fold, and a customer’s answer joins the same conversation.
steps: Press “2 earlier messages”, then Reply all.

shots.label: A conversation with Cc and Bcc

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
